# Roadmap

Live work runs on the [pqscan Roadmap board](https://github.com/users/shsingh/projects/6)
(Target = milestone, Status = execution state) with the M0 register on
[issue #4](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/issues/4) — native
`blocked-by` edges enforce the order.

## Milestones

| Milestone | Scope | State |
|---|---|---|
| **M0** — measurement and decision gate | Engine spikes measured (TCP matrix, QUIC plane, microbench), language verdict re-scored (re-affirm ADR-0001 or fire the kill-switch) | in progress — see the [register](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/issues/4) for leaf states |
| **M1** — fast mode + output dialect | Target grammar, fast handshakes, JSONL/CSV/text/URLs out, exit codes, `-stats`, docs drift check | pending |
| **M2** — PQC classification + deep mode | IANA regen pipeline, scoring rubric + verdicts, deep plan executor, differential vs gnutls-cli-debug | pending |
| **M3** — scale hardening | Budgets/AIMD/breakers, WAL resume, SLO suite in CI, shard mode | pending |
| **M4** — QUIC plane + enrichment | h3 via direct QUIC handshake, PQ-in-QUIC, PTR pool + SNI strategies, `-certs-dir` | pending |
| **M5** — release | goreleaser binaries with SLSA provenance (ADR-0003), JSON schema, fixture results publish | pending |

Acceptance criteria per milestone live in
[`docs/spec.md#9-milestones`](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/docs/spec.md#9-milestones)
— no milestones are time-bound; the gates are criteria, not dates.

## Current gate (M0)

The measurement and decision gate: every engine claim is measured, not
asserted. The leaf lanes and their live statuses are on the
[register](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/issues/4); first-live-run
findings (forced 4588 negotiated against a hybrid endpoint; the obsolete-Kyber
oracle provoking an HRR demanding the draft group) are recorded on the
respective issues as verbatim run comments.
